notes: The 1984 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: the year's many namings (Boeddeker Park, Potrero del Sol, Mission Center, Herbst Road, the Eskey koala exhibit), dedications and contracts.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: Yerba Buena Senior Center renamed Rosa Parks Senior Center (Res. 13556), Hunters Point Recreation Center keeping Milton Meyer as its building name (Res. 13684), Martin Luther King, Jr. Drive dedication, the Holocaust Memorial setting (Asa Hanamoto), Portsmouth Square master plan funding (no place pages or not placed).
coverage.note: Dated by footers. Curated list F1984.py.

findings.description: On the neighborhood's proposal, the Recreation and Park Commission named Central City Park the Alfred Boeddeker Neighborhood Park; Father Boeddeker had won 46 of the 70 votes cast in a naming poll run with the North of Market Planning Coalition and The Tenderloin Times.
